D7: A GATE'S PROBES, superseding D6's coined 'handler list'. Akien 2026-10-27: 'each device can add probes to a gate... a list of handlers and data to give them as opposed to probes that are compiled in to pieces of python' and ''handler list' you mean the probes? a probe can be a lot of things. a probe can be a json packet: { event: eventname, message: {event} on {ticket} }, or a surgically implanted piece of code that reports back some metric.' So the gate holds a list of probes, and certification fires each one. This ticket builds the data kind only: a JSON probe {to: <bus address>, event: <eventname>, message: '<template over {event} and {ticket}>'}, fired as one 'personal' envelope to its 'to', whose body is D3's fields plus the rendered message. The code kind (cairn.tools.base.probe.Probe, with trigger/carry callables) is untouched and out of scope here. Today the list holds one probe: {to: 'cc', event: 'certified', message: '{event} on {ticket}'}. Where a gate's probes live is open-413b07bf8322.

D8: WHERE A GATE'S PROBES LIVE (Akien 2026-10-27, open-413b07bf8322 and open-a0e22798522e): at the gate, in instance-space, one JSON file per probe: '~/.cairn/devices/codemother/machines/gate/build/probes/*.json <- the json files point to the handlers that get notified that this ticket is ready for them.' With the instance segment CLAUDE.md requires (a singleton is 0), the path is ~/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/machines/gate/<gate>/probes/*.json. <gate> is the summons the crossing enters with ME dropped and lowercased (BUILDME -> build, PROVEME -> prove, FIXME -> fix, WATCHME -> watch, TICKETME -> ticket), and PROVED -> proved; CC's call, overridable. At certification, emit reads that folder and fires each probe (D7's JSON shape). A missing or empty folder fires nothing. A malformed probe file is reported on stderr and skipped, never gating. 'Clear all the probes across all devices for <device>' is a verb that deletes every probes/*.json under ~/.cairn/devices/*/*/machines/gate/*/ whose 'to' is <device>. Seeded today with one probe per gate: {to: 'cc', event: 'certified', message: '{event} on {ticket}'}.

D9: FIRING. The event of every crossing is 'certified'. For each probe file in the entered gate's folder, in filename order, whose 'event' equals 'certified', post one envelope through RemoteBus: sender 'cairn', to=probe['to'], channel 'personal', verb=probe['event'], why=the rendered message, body = D3's six fields + {'probe': <file stem>, 'message': <rendered>} + D4's 'testing' when set. Rendering is str.format(event=probe['event'], ticket=<ticket id>) and nothing else. A probe whose event is not 'certified' fires nothing today. A malformed probe is reported on stderr and skipped: not a JSON object, a missing or non-string to/event/message, or a template naming any other key. The rendered message replaces D3's why.

D10: SEED AND CLEAR. New module cairn/tools/base/gate_probes.py owns the folder, with every path built from cairn.tools.base.address.instance_path('codemother', 0, roots)/'machines'/'gate'/<gate>/'probes' (the roots argument lets proofs point at a temp dir). GATES = ('build','prove','fix','watch','ticket','proved'). gate_for(summons) maps BUILDME->build, PROVEME->prove, FIXME->fix, WATCHME->watch, TICKETME->ticket, PROVED->proved, and anything else to None, which fires nothing. load(gate, roots=None) returns (probes, errors). seed(device, roots=None) writes <device>.json = {to: device, event: 'certified', message: '{event} on {ticket}'} into each of the six gates and leaves an existing file untouched. clear(device, roots=None) deletes every devices/*/*/machines/gate/*/probes/*.json under the instance root whose 'to' is device and returns the deleted paths. CLI: python3 -m cairn.tools.base.gate_probes seed|clear|list <device>. The live step runs 'seed cc' once. emit's firing function (D2) calls load().

D11: PROOFS (extends D5's teeth). Proofs live in cairn/tools/base/proofs/ over a temp roots table and a stand-in RemoteBus, binding the subject at call time. Teeth: envelope shape (one probe, one personal envelope with D9's fields); unreachable bus (emit returns and journals, nothing raises); testing mark under CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID; missing or empty folder posts nothing; malformed probe skipped with a stderr line while a good sibling still fires; seed writes six files and is idempotent; clear removes only the named device's files.

D12: API AND SCOPE. gate_probes.load(gate, roots=None) returns (probes, errors): probes is a list of (file_stem, dict) in filename order, and errors is a list of strings. gate_probes.fire(*, ticket, component, from_, to, direction, fingerprint, roots=None, bus=None) does D9's posting; bus=None means cairn.tools.bus_client.remote.RemoteBus() (no args = the live bus home), posted as bus.post(sender='cairn', to=..., channel='personal', why=..., verb=..., body=...). A missing socket raises FileNotFoundError or ConnectionRefusedError, which D5 catches. In emit, history_path is emit's own keyword argument. When it is None, or does not resolve under the cairn repo root (Path(transitions.__file__).resolve().parents[3]), or the crossing carries no ticket in journal_extra, nothing fires: a proof's temp-dir crossing never reaches the live bus. Otherwise emit computes component = history_path's parent relative to that root and calls gate_probes.fire inside D5's catch-all. Proof files follow cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_crossing_fingerprint.py: plain test_* functions plus a __main__ runner, exit 0 = green. The proof stand-in bus is an object whose post(**kw) appends kw to a list (or raises ConnectionRefusedError for the unreachable tooth), passed as bus=.
